mc_certification.argument: For any invalid fixed setting, at least one governing constraint is false. Incorrect certification of that all-constraints intersection is bounded by that constraint's alpha=1/1500. Union over 75 possible selected settings is <=0.05; no independence between settings or simultaneous per-cell coverage assertion is needed.
mc_certification.limitations: Assumes the specified independent-outer-replicate Monte Carlo model. Exact indexed pseudorandom semantics and bound numeric environment require implementation validation. Not a real-market model certificate.

INFORMATIONAL.finding: The result is a finite-envelope conditional feature-clock operating-characteristic certificate. Generated Opens are not a fitted continuation of the TRAIN Close process, and the four interleaved chains do not impose an empirical one-hour return-overlap model.
INFORMATIONAL.consequence: A later passing trial supports only the declared conditional model; it cannot establish real-market calendar power or executable profitability.

INFORMATIONAL.finding: Only (D,V,s)=(2,2,12) can possibly satisfy the four-month utility budget and the declared support grid. B_eff cannot exceed the number of non-overlapping 120h blocks. A one-month stage has at most seven blocks; each two-month stage has at most thirteen.
INFORMATIONAL.consequence: The other utility tuples have mathematically impossible full-pipeline power. This is a prospective upper bound, not a measured power result; (2,2,12) remains unproven.

INFORMATIONAL.finding: There are 11863110020400 indexed logical outer records. run_root includes cell, truth, D, V, support and outer index, so broad common-RNG or identical-null reuse across settings is not already part of the frozen stochastic contract.
INFORMATIONAL.consequence: Trial 1 remains blocked until an independently proven equivalent resource/replay plan exists; static table reuse alone does not establish affordable execution.

INFORMATIONAL.finding: TRAIN source custody, reachable rate profiles, aliases, and bounded consistent mean fields have not been materialized.
INFORMATIONAL.consequence: These receipts may fail and block the whole method. A failed receipt cannot authorize choosing another source, deleting a cell or roster slot, clipping a mean, or relaxing a constraint.

INFORMATIONAL.finding: The 1/1500 selection-safe Monte Carlo certificate is mathematically conservative and explicitly proposed for Controller acceptance. Nominal 95% admissibility is separately reported.
INFORMATIONAL.consequence: It may withhold a certified schedule despite nominal admissibility. Such withholding cannot be labeled a failed nominal scientific gate or a proven utility failure.

INFORMATIONAL.finding: The calendar budget excludes the fixed 48h audit gap; a nonempty nominal or certified diagnostic schedule outside the budget does not supply a utility schedule. An empty utility selection is represented by the schema's null selected pair and per-pair calendar statuses.
INFORMATIONAL.consequence: Report actual elapsed UTC schedules and both nominal/certified utility status. No favorable rescheduling, larger-support rescue, or nonutility schedule can be promoted to four-month success.
